descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S25 Real dictation into boxes on iPhone and Android: word for word against a script, silence stays empty, engine and timing recorded

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 step 1)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U3 A box that starts with a room number (e.g. 'bed 415…') shows a room chip, and the picker suggests that room's patient. The physician still taps to assign; nothing auto-assigns. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 4; TFA-92582 step 4; TFA-92583 AC 3)
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 2; TFA-92583 AC 2)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Run by a person on the build Daniela names (store builds use the dev backend, which the agent never touches), or on a Capacitor debug build pointed at the local stack (127.0.0.1:4510); @roundai.test account only, never the store-review fixed-code account; synthetic QA Hosp patients in rooms 415 and 416

When Read a fixed script into each box: box 1 'Bed 415, potassium 3.1, give KCl 40 mEq by mouth once, metoprolol held.'; box 2 'Bed 416, sodium 131, hold furosemide, recheck BMP at 6 am.'; tap Stop, place both. Box 3: tap Dictate and stay silent for 10 s, then Stop. Deny the mic once; …

Then Each box holds only its own words, the same words as the script; the silent box stays empty; the chip appears from the dictated room (or the spoken form is recorded for Q2); placing works as on the web; a blocked mic shows 'Mic didn't start — tap Dictate again.'; the keyboard does not hide the caret

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Compare each box with its script word for word: any changed number, unit or drug name, or any added word, is a Fail and is quoted (3.4); punctuation and capitals are not counted. Any text in the silent box is a Fail, quoted. Per dictation record the engine (GPT-Live expected, 3.9), the time from Stop to text in the box, and the transcribe call's aiCallLog.providerMs (read from …

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S25 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
